356309.title: A binomial-hypergeometric identity for graph-count coefficients
356309.mechanism: With N=l+2g the identity depends only on (N,j). Writing the terminating 2F1 explicitly gives LHS = 2^{N-1} j! [x^j](1+x)^{2j}(1-x)^{-(N-1)}; RHS = 4^j j! [y^j](1-y)^{-1/2}(1+(1-y)^{-1/2})^{N-1}. Lagrange inversion with x=t(1+x)^2, t=y/4, s=sqrt(1-y): 1+x=2/(1+s), 1-x=2s/(1+s), 1-t phi'(x)=s, so both sides agree for all N>=2, j>=0.
356309.coverage: Exact check of literal identity and intermediate form: g<=12, l<=24, j<=24 (7200 cases), all equal.
356309.limitations: Classical one-step Lagrange inversion; likely judged routine; Lean formalization not attempted. Prior-art for an existing proof not searched beyond registry path screen.

358158.title: Optimality of TC-dominant generating sets for odd-length secondary structure avoidance codes
358158.review_depth: full source body read (Sections II-V, Table I, Conjecture 1); cited constructions checked; follow-up journal abstract read, journal body unread (IEEE 202 challenge, not retried)
358158.mechanism: Simulated-annealing search over generating sets in S_5 (one word from each of the 512 reverse-complement pairs) found S5 = TC-dominant set with 22 weight-3 words swapped for their reverse complements; spectral radius 3.2480375901 > 3.2443334586 (TC). Integer Collatz-Wielandt certificates (lambda=1299/400 lower on S5, mu=649/200 upper on TC) give |C_n(S5)| >= c1 lambda^n, |C_n(TC)| <= c2 mu^n.
358158.coverage: m=3: annealing reproduces source optimum (no improvement); m=5: 9 annealing runs, best 3.2480375901 reached by 3 seeds; m=7: 3 capped runs (random-start, TC-start, boundary-restricted), no improvement over TC 3.4099611800.
358158.lean: formal/SSA5 (7 modules); endpoints SSA.conjecture1_false_limsup, SSA.conjecture1_false_liminf, SSA.rate_limit_gap, SSA.conjecture1_false_m5; fresh extracted strict rebuild + leanchecker pass; 198 declarations audited, axioms only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound.
